sql.query: UPDATE tbl_event_statuses es SET es.isActive=0,es.isDefault=0,es.modifiedByUserId=:modifiedByUserId,es.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE es.id=:id AND es.tenantId=:tenantId AND es.isDefault=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=es.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
